title: Your $5,000 bonus: the rich turn it into a paycheck 💸
description:
Do the rich really blow their year-end bonus?
Your bonus buys a TV. Theirs buys shares, slices of businesses, that grow and then pay out every year (at an assumed {bonus_rate} a year of growth, then taking out {pay_fee_pct} a year).
An animated story with illustrative numbers; the characters are not advisers.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
